title: Synovial Fluid Analysis of Intraarticular Elbow Fracture
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to obtain and compare bilateral elbow joint synovial fluid from patients with unilateral intraarticular elbow fracture and a contralateral healthy appearing elbow joint. The synovial fluid samples will undergo several forms of analysis for metabolites and proteins. Matched-pair statistical analysis will be performed to determine the metabolites and proteins that may play the greatest role in development of joint contracture.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years and older
* Intraarticular elbow fracture (humerus, radial head and/or ulna fracture)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 years
* Open elbow fracture
* Bilateral elbow fractures
* Patients with history of osteomyelitis of elbow
* Inflammatory arthropathy (ie. Rheumatoid arthritis)
* Prior surgery on fractured elbow
